verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
I will wait for You as long as it takes
I've given up my life over to stay

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
You've been searching for, how You've been yearning for
Hearts loyal to Your own
So as You search the earth looking for Your friends
Hear me sing, my Lord

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
I am Yours, yes, I am
Wholly Yours
I am Yours, yes, I am
Wholly Yours

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
I will wait for You as long as You want
I've give up my life over for love

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
You are my first love, You are my only One
Lord, there is no one else for me
Where else can I go, You have my heart alone
You are the only One I need
